title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: which Statement Cycle is reconciled for excess withdrawal fees after overdraft protection transfers
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Savings & Money Market Accounts account from which overdraft protection transfers have been made, when its excess withdrawal fees are reconciled. It fixes which Statement Cycle is reconciled, and when nothing is reconciled.

## Policy clause

1. The Statement Cycle reconciled is the Statement Cycle of the most recent overdraft protection transfer, that is the most recent withdrawal on this account posted as an overdraft protection transfer.
2. That transfer is taken only when its counterparty is a checking account of the same customer, the account the transfer covered.
3. When that counterparty is not one of the customer's checking accounts, nothing is reconciled under this rule.
4. When overdraft protection transfers to different accounts posted on that most recent date, the records do not show which of them is the most recent, and nothing is reconciled under this rule.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The overdraft protection transfers, their counterparty, posted dates and Statement Cycles are read from the savings account's transaction record; whether the counterparty is one of the customer's checking accounts is read from the bank's checking records.
- **Object correlation.** Only the single most recent overdraft protection transfer decides the Statement Cycle.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the savings account's withdrawals posted as overdraft protection transfers.
- **Judgement 1:** take the one posted most recently.
- **Judgement 2:** did overdraft protection transfers to different accounts post on that date? If so, stop: nothing is reconciled.
- **Judgement 3:** is its counterparty a checking account of the same customer? If not, stop: nothing is reconciled.
- **Output:** its Statement Cycle is the Statement Cycle reconciled.

## Worked case (hypothetical dates)

| Withdrawal | Posted | Statement Cycle | Counterparty |
|---|---|---|---|
| overdraft protection transfer | 26 February | February | the customer's checking account |
| overdraft protection transfer | 4 March | March | the customer's checking account |
| telephone transfer to the same checking account | 9 March | March | the customer's checking account |

The most recent overdraft protection transfer is the one of 4 March, and its counterparty is the customer's own checking account, so the Statement Cycle reconciled is March. The telephone transfer of 9 March is not an overdraft protection transfer and does not decide the Statement Cycle.

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "Pick the Statement Cycle by the date of the call." **Correct basis:** the Statement Cycle is that of the most recent overdraft protection transfer.

**The most recent overdraft protection transfer went to an account that is not one of the customer's checking accounts. Which Statement Cycle is reconciled?** None; nothing is reconciled under this rule.
